phase_name: /sapience Pick Surface -- Stage 1 Into the One Approval Picker

objectives.description: Stage 1: rewrite the binding gate -- missing/invalid link file no longer stops; run read-only pick, carry listing forward as a candidate surface
objectives.note: Adopted exactly-one-or-refuse disambiguation (mirroring Stage 5's collaborator-resolution discipline) for the zero-row and multi-row cases, since the plan's description names a singular preview id but the pick can list more than one row.

objectives.description: Stage 7: add Project binding preview via --project <id> with no --confirm
Stage 8: add binding row inside the existing askuserquestion-option-construction marker pair; update four->five ceiling wording
Stage 9: add binding option object with role note + pointer to printed payload
Stage 10: confirmed bind re-invokes identical Stage 7 vector with --confirm appended
Stage 11: report bind's three distinct outcomes by name (written+registered; written-locally-only 404; refused-nothing-written 403)
Update Stage 8 surface-ceiling wording from four to five options, and matching sentence in Stage 9 preamble
objectives.note: Also corrected two further stale 'four' counts in Stage 11's own prose (the five-surfaces/five-success-shapes intro and the five-cases-never-retried closing line) since the plan's own new fifth bullet sits directly beside them -- a plain correctness fix beyond the two sites the task bullet named explicitly.

deviations.description: Stage 1 pick-to-single-candidate resolution when the pick lists more than one accepted/owned project
deviations.reason: The dispatch description and plan task list name a single preview/bind id ('--project "<id>"') but sapience-project-bind.sh's pick mode can return any number of rows; the plan itself does not specify a disambiguation rule. Reused Stage 5's existing exactly-one-or-refuse discipline (never silently guess) rather than inventing a new mechanism or adding a second AskUserQuestion (explicitly a Non-Goal).
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- added explicit zero-row/multi-row UNAVAILABLE handling, reusing Stage 5's exactly-one-or-refuse discipline, since the plan's single-id framing underspecified the multi-row case)*
